title: 第15章 安全顾问第16章 柳初晴
lines: “你们……认识？”好半天，海流沙才问出一句话。
江来翘着二郎腿，自顾自的从口袋中摸出一根香烟叼在嘴里。他之所以认识比尔森，主要是因为圣殿的规矩和传统。作为世界地下势力的王者，圣殿喜欢网罗各个行业的精英和顶尖人才，比尔森身为世界顶尖级的安保专家，自然也在圣殿的招揽范围内。
类似比尔森这样的圣殿成员平时很少跟圣殿打交道，他们都有自己的生活，圣殿只是暗中提供保护，或者帮忙解决麻烦，作为回报，只要圣殿有需要，这些精英人才必须全力以赴。
在这些圣殿成员中，他跟比尔森最为熟识，因为圣殿很多分部的安保系统都由比尔森负责。一来二去，两人见面多了，自然熟了。
“海小姐，你我都是大忙人，不妨爽快一点，节约大家的时间。既然比尔森来了，总不能让他空手回去，要不这样，你聘请我当你的安全顾问，他来给我当副手。南月集团作为世界五百强企业，资产雄厚，应该不会在乎多开一个人的工资，你觉得呢？”
海流沙沉默了片刻，缓缓道：“我需要考虑一下。”
“考虑？”江来挪了挪屁股，换了个舒服的坐姿，道：“海小姐，我知道你不喜欢我，说实话，我对你也没什么兴趣，要不是因为你姐姐，我才懒得陪你在这浪费时间。不过，如果你想活命的话，最好答应我的条件。”
听他再次提到卿曼容，海流沙的美眸深处顿时闪过一抹异色，还有一丝不易察觉的冷芒，“好！”她点点头道：“我答应你，聘请你们两位做我的安全顾问，希望你们不会让我失望。”
“你总算做了个明智的决定。”江来咧嘴笑道：“要是没别的事情，那我们先走了。”
“喂！”一旁的阮香不悦道：“既然董事长已经录用你们，那你们是不是应该先做正事？现在外面有人想对董事长不利，你们多拖一天，只会让董事长的安全受到威胁。”
“那倒也是。比尔森，这里的事情就交给你了，忙完之后给我打电话。”说完，江来拍拍屁股，头也不回的走出了办公室。
看到他消极怠工的表现，阮香不由气急，“董事长，你看看他，太不把您放在眼里了，一点做员工的觉悟都没有。”
“算了！”海流沙从门口收回目光，淡淡的说道：“随他去吧，你先带比尔森先生熟悉下周围的环境。”
“是，董事长。”
随着阮香和比尔森离开办公室，海流沙拿起办公桌上的座机电话，拨通了一个号码。几分钟后，一名中年男子快步从门外走了进来，惶惶不安道：“董事长，您找我？”
“钟强，想必你已经知道了，我刚聘请了两位安保顾问，他们……”
“董事长，您别说了，我明白。”钟强面色微白，苦笑着道：“我马上提交辞呈。”
“你清楚就好。”顿了顿，海流沙话锋一转，问道：“如果我没记错的话，你在入职前曾是特种兵出身，立过很多战功。”
“是，我是京区103特种部队的侦察兵，属于军区的王牌部队。”
“这些年你做得不错，勤勤恳恳，任劳任怨，只是，以你的能力可能不太适合做管理，更适合冲锋陷阵。”
听到这话，钟强面露不解，道：“董事长，我不太明白您的意思。”
“我有一个任务，需要找一个信得过的人去做。既然你以前是侦察兵，想必收集情报的能力不弱，不知道你有没有兴趣？你放心，只要这件事情办好了，我不会亏待你。”
“真的？”钟强目光一亮，忙不迭的应道：“董事长只管吩咐，我一定不会让您失望。”
“很好！”
回到华庭御府的住处，江来拿出叶芙渠的笔记本，登入一个网站，然后输入一连串的代码，随着回车键敲下，只见电脑屏幕突然变黑，无数乱码显现出来。见状，他眉头微皱，直接一拳砸了下去，将笔记本彻底破坏。
看来安德鲁已经全面接管了圣殿，不仅连内部网站都登入不进去，对方还设置了反追踪程序，只要他输入圣殿国王独有的代码，就会启动程序。幸好他反应及时，不然的话，圣殿已经锁定他的位置了。
一想到自己目前的处境，江来感觉有些头疼，圣殿，海流沙，卿曼容，还有隐藏在卿曼容背后的神秘势力，这些都堆积在他的心里，犹如一块沉重的石头，压得他喘不过气来。
这个时候，门外面突然响起一阵急促的敲门声，似乎有人在用拳头锤击着防盗门。
“快开门，警察！”
“警察？”江来慢腾腾的站起身，挪动到门口，随手打开门，顿时，一名彪悍的男子立刻出现在他眼前，身后还尾随着七八名身穿便衣的警察。
“徐警官，就是他，他就是杀人凶手！”在人群后面，江来看到了一张熟悉的面孔，正是那天被他所伤的谭平。此刻，对方手指着他的鼻子，脸色愤恨，眼中藏着一丝深深的怨毒之色。
彪悍男子一手放在鼓鼓的腰间，神情冷峻，另一只手拿着手铐，看着江来轻喝道：“把手举起来。”
江来耸耸肩，也不知是没听到，还是故意选择无视，转身走进了客厅，淡然自若的在沙发上落座，然后掏出一包香烟。看到他的举动，彪悍男子皱了皱眉，冷冷道：“我让你把手举起来，听到没有？”
“这位警官，非常抱歉，我的耳朵不太好，你说什么我听不清楚。”
“哼！我看你是敬酒不吃吃罚酒。来人，把他抓起来！”
几名便衣应了一声，快步冲了上去，想要将江来擒住。这时，刚刚点燃一支香烟的江来屈指一弹，滚烫的烟头立刻飞了出去，正好落在一名便衣的头发上。顿时，青烟冒出，那人立刻痛得哇哇大叫起来，拼命甩动着脑袋。
旁边几名同伴见状，急忙停下脚步，帮着他将烟头清理干净。
“几位，真是不好意思，刚才手滑没夹住。”江来笑眯眯的说道。然而，他的笑容并没有维持多久，便慢慢凝固起来，墨澈的瞳仁中寒光闪烁。
content_en:
"You... know each other?" It took a long time for Hai Liusha to ask.
Jiang Lai crossed his legs and took out a cigarette from his pocket and held it in his mouth. He knew Pilsen primarily because of the temple's rules and traditions. As the king of the world's underground forces, the Temple likes to recruit elites and top talents from various industries. As the world's top security expert, Bilson is naturally within the scope of the Temple's recruitment.
Temple members like Bilson rarely interact with the Temple. They all have their own lives. The Temple only provides protection secretly or helps solve troubles. In return, these elites must go all out as long as the Temple is in need.
Among these temple members, he was most familiar with Bilson, because Bilson was responsible for the security system of many branches of the temple. After going back and forth, the two of them met more often and naturally became familiar with each other.
"Miss Hai, you and I are both busy people, so we might as well be more relaxed and save everyone's time. Now that Bilson is here, we can't let him go back empty-handed. Otherwise, you hire me as your security consultant and he will be my deputy. As a Fortune 500 company with strong assets, Nanyue Group shouldn't care about paying an extra person's salary. What do you think?"
Hai Liusha was silent for a moment and said slowly: "I need to think about it."
"Consider?" Jiang Lai moved his buttocks, changed to a comfortable sitting position, and said: "Miss Hai, I know you don't like me. To be honest, I have no interest in you. If it weren't for your sister, I wouldn't be too lazy to waste time here with you. However, if you want to survive, you'd better agree to my conditions."
Hearing him mention Qing Manrong again, a strange color suddenly flashed in the depths of Hai Liusha's beautiful eyes, and there was also a hint of coldness that was hard to detect. "Okay!" She nodded and said, "I promise you to hire you two as my security consultants. I hope you won't let me down."
"You finally made a wise decision." Jiang Lai grinned and said, "If there is nothing else, let's leave first."
"Hey!" Ruan Xiang said displeasedly: "Since the chairman has hired you, shouldn't you do your business first? There are people outside who want to harm the chairman. If you delay for one more day, the chairman's safety will only be threatened."
"That's true. Bilson, I'll leave the affairs here to you. Give me a call when you're done." After saying that, Jiang Lai patted his butt and walked out of the office without looking back.
Seeing his passive and slow performance, Ruan Xiang couldn't help but get angry, "Chairman, look at him. He doesn't take you seriously. He doesn't have the consciousness to be an employee at all."
"Forget it!" Hai Liusha withdrew his gaze from the door and said calmly: "Let him go. You first take Mr. Bilson to familiarize himself with the surrounding environment."
"Yes, Chairman."
As Ruan Xiang and Bilson left the office, Hai Liusha picked up the landline phone on his desk and dialed a number. A few minutes later, a middle-aged man walked in quickly from the door and said anxiously: "Chairman, are you looking for me?"
"Zhong Qiang, I believe you already know that I have just hired two security consultants. They..."
"Chairman, please stop talking, I understand." Zhong Qiang turned pale and said with a wry smile, "I will submit my resignation immediately."
"As long as you understand." After a pause, Hai Liusha changed the topic and asked, "If I remember correctly, you were a special forces soldier before joining the army and made many military exploits."
"Yes, I am a scout of the 103rd Special Forces Unit in the Beijing District. I belong to the ace unit of the military district."
"You have done well over the years. You are diligent and hard-working. However, your ability may not be suitable for management and is more suitable for charging into battle."
Hearing this, Zhong Qiang looked puzzled and said: "Chairman, I don't quite understand what you mean."
"I have a task and I need to find a trustworthy person to do it. Since you were a scout before, you must be good at gathering intelligence. I wonder if you are interested? Don't worry, as long as this matter is done, I will not treat you badly."
"Really?" Zhong Qiang's eyes lit up and he responded hurriedly: "Chairman, just give your orders, I will not let you down."
"Very good!"
…
Back at Huating Yufu's residence, Jiang Lai took out Ye Fuqu's notebook, logged into a website, and then entered a series of codes. As he hit the Enter key, the computer screen suddenly turned black and countless garbled codes appeared. Seeing this, he frowned slightly and punched it, completely destroying the notebook.
It seems that Andrew has completely taken over the temple. Not only can he not log in to the internal website, the other party has also set up an anti-tracking program. As long as he enters the unique code of the temple king, the program will be launched. Fortunately, he reacted in time, otherwise, the temple would have locked his location.
Jiang Lai felt a headache when he thought about his current situation. The temple, Hai Liusha, Qing Manrong, and the mysterious force hidden behind Qing Manrong all piled up in his heart, like a heavy stone, making him breathless.
"Bang! Bang! Bang!"
At this time, there was a sudden knock on the door, as if someone was hammering on the security door with their fists.
"Open the door, police!"
"Police?" Jiang Lai stood up slowly, moved to the door, and opened the door. Suddenly, a tough man appeared in front of him, followed by seven or eight plainclothes policemen.
"Officer Xu, that's him, he's the murderer!" Behind the crowd, Jiang Lai saw a familiar face, it was Tan Ping who was injured by him that day. At this moment, the other party was pointing at his nose, with an angry look on his face, and a trace of deep resentment hidden in his eyes.
The tough man put one hand on his bulging waist with a stern expression, and held handcuffs in the other hand. He looked at Jiang Lai and shouted softly: "Put your hands up."
Jiang Lai shrugged, not knowing whether he didn't hear it or deliberately chose to ignore it. He turned and walked into the living room, sat down on the sofa calmly, and then took out a pack of cigarettes. Seeing his actions, the tough man frowned and said coldly: "I asked you to raise your hands, do you hear me?"
"Officer, I'm very sorry. My ears are not very good. I can't hear you clearly."
"Hmph! I think you're going to drink wine as a penalty instead of toasting. Come on, arrest him!"
Several plainclothes men responded and rushed forward quickly, trying to capture Jiang Lai. At this time, Jiang Lai, who had just lit a cigarette, flicked it with his finger, and the hot cigarette butt immediately flew out and landed on the hair of a plainclothes man. Suddenly, green smoke came out, and the man immediately screamed in pain and shook his head desperately.
When several companions nearby saw this, they hurriedly stopped and helped him clean up the cigarette butts.
"Guys, I'm really sorry, my hands slipped and I didn't clamp them just now." Jiang Lai said with a smile. However, his smile did not last long before it slowly solidified, and a cold light flashed in Mo Che's pupils.
title_en: Chapter 15 Security Consultant Chapter 16 Liu Chuqing
